capex_override.reason: Ralph Lauren files FY2026 capital expenditures under us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment, a tag the engine does not read, so companyfacts has no full-year FY2026 value under PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets (only Q1-Q3 YTD). The 10-K cash-flow statement reports $408.1M for FY2026. Value is 1.89x the last filed FY2025 capex of $216.2M, inside the 0.1x-10x band.
capex_override.source: Ralph Lauren FY2026 Form 10-K filed 2026-05-21 (accession 0001628280-26-037074), Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, period ended 2026-03-28: Capital expenditures (408.1) tagged us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireMachineryAndEquipment, scale 6 (millions); FY2025 comparative (216.2) on the same line

moat_against: No switching costs or network effects - consumers can move to rival luxury/premium brands freely
Aspirational (not ultra-high-net-worth) customer base is macro and discretionary-spending sensitive
Fashion and brand-heat cyclicality - taste shifts can erode pricing power
Tariff and Asia sourcing exposure pressures gross margin; sourcing diversified but not immune
Founder-linked brand identity is a long-term succession / narrative risk
moat_for: Nearly 60-year iconic American luxury brand with proven pricing power - AUR up mid-teens in FY2026, gross margin 69.9%
Full-price DTC model and key-city flagship ecosystem raise direct consumer control and lifetime value
Balanced global footprint (North America / Europe / Asia) and multi-category lifestyle breadth
High returns on capital held through cycles; OE positive 5 of last 5 fiscal years
Net cash balance sheet supports brand investment through downturns
moat_justification: Strong, durable brand moat (narrow-wide): proven pricing power and full-price selling through cycles, but no switching costs or network effects and fashion/macro exposure cap it below wide-moat 8+. Score 6/10.
name: Ralph Lauren Corporation
one_liner: High-quality luxury brand, moat 6/10, but priced far above owner's-earnings value - weighted IRR 7.4% and IV@15 $141 vs $392 price (Tier D); clears 15% only near $141.
